name: ai-software-architect
description: Architecture-first analysis using your Codex model, with transparent local hooks for deterministic safety and response quality.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture decisions with transparent local guardrails
interface.longDescription: Explicitly invoke $ai-software-architect to compare options, approve durable decisions, prepare coding handoffs, and review conformance. Recommended local hooks add deterministic invocation guidance, focused-reference injection, structurally bounded architect-tool checks, focused option-rendering validation, and a hidden outcome marker so recommendations reliably offer the user's next choice. They make no model or network calls, do not bypass Codex permissions, and persist no prompt or repository content. Review their source and tests at https://github.com/leomuf/ai-software-architect#why-codex-asks-you-to-trust-the-hooks.
defaultPrompt: $ai-software-architect Design the architecture before we implement this feature.
$ai-software-architect Create an ADR and architecture contract for this decision.
$ai-software-architect Review this implementation against our architecture contract.
